issues.description: Alice cannot reach the SwiftRoute workspace after login — OIDC callback loop. After Keycloak issues the authorisation code for the swiftroute realm, the workspace application enters a redirect loop and never delivers the dashboard. ISS-0072 Fix 1 (tenant-config API) and Fix 2 (realm routing) are confirmed live. The token exchange / auth callback handling is not using the swiftroute OIDC authority — root cause to be diagnosed in WF-03.
